Quelle Profession ?

A listening & matching exercise on professions vocabulary — taught by Karla, in English.

Professeure : Karla
Les métiers
Audio
Piste 91
Nine people talk about their job, one after another. You can replay the track as many times as you like while you work through the exercises below.
Instructions

Listen, then match the people to their profession

« Écoutez les personnes qui parlent de leur profession. Associez les photos et les personnes. Pour chaque photo, trouvez dans la liste suivante le nom de la profession au masculin et au féminin. »

Listen to the people talking about their profession. Match the photos to the people. For each photo, find in the list below the name of the profession, in both its masculine and feminine forms.

Les photos
a
b
c
d
e
f
g
h
i

As you listen to each speaker, decide which lettered photo (a–i) matches their job.

Exercice 1

Associez chaque personne à sa photo

For each speaker (1 to 9, in the order you hear them), choose the letter of the matching photo.

Score : 0/9
Exercice 2

Trouvez le métier de chaque photo

For each photo, choose its profession — masculine and feminine form together.

Score : 0/9
